title: Add MEG-XL backbone fine-tune path
description: MIT, ~567 MB weights into DataRoot.foreign('MEG-XL'). README asks 40-80 GiB; test bf16 / grad-checkpoint / smaller batch on the 5090.
design: DESIGN 2026-10-02 20:22Z. HOLDOUT CONSTRAINT (probed subj00 archives): 156 sentence epochs, 868 words, each epoch STARTS at first word onset (0 s pre-onset), ends 1.02-1.36 s (p0/p50) after last onset, median length 2.5 s; plus 92 isolated 1 s word epochs. MEG-XL's own recipe (3 s per word from -0.5 s, baseline first 0.5 s, concatenated) is NOT reproducible at holdout. Adaptation: feed each span's CONTINUOUS segment [first onset, last onset + 1.0 s] at our 50 Hz cache, padded to the batch max; isolated words = 1 s segment. Train segments cut identically (no pre-onset, same tail) so train/holdout match. Trunk out [B,C,T/12,512] = 240 ms tokens; word feature = mean over channels x tokens covering [onset, onset+0.5 s] -> MLP -> context width, replacing WordNet slots in SentenceNet (strategy: ContextConfig.encoder = conv|megxl). Scaling: per-segment RobustScaler per channel + clip 5 (also 4te.10's normalisation). PLUMBING: external/MEG-XL has no pyproject -> committed fetch step (git clone + checkout 97da041) and importlib load with sys.path; optional extra megxl = pytorch-lightning, einops (only third-party deps of trunk+BioCodec); deptry DEP002 ignore with reason.
